subproblem.title: Tangential divergence of the height test field X(y) = zeta(y)^2 p_{T^perp}(y - z) (Simon 5.2.1, displays (1)-(3))
subproblem.statement: Let n, l in N, U any subset of R^{n+l}, V a rectifiable n-varifold in U (contract structure RectifiableVarifold n l U), zeta : R^{n+l} -> R, z, x in R^{n+l}, and P, T linear subspaces of R^{n+l} of dimension n; write p_W = W.starProjection for the orthogonal projection onto a subspace W, D zeta(x) = fderiv R zeta x, and hsNormSq for the squared Hilbert-Schmidt norm. Assume zeta is differentiable at x and V.tangentProj x = p_P. Then the vector field X(y) := zeta(y)^2 p_{T^perp}(y - z) satisfies V.divM X x (= trace(DX(x) o V.tangentProj x)) = zeta(x)^2 * hsNormSq(V.tangentProj x - p_T)/2 + 2 zeta(x) * D zeta(x)((V.tangentProj x - p_T)(p_{T^perp}(x - z))).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (ζ : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (z x : Amb n ℓ) (P T : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)), DifferentiableAt ℝ ζ x → Module.finrank ℝ P = n → Module.finrank ℝ T = n → V.tangentProj x = P.starProjection → V.divM (fun y => ζ y ^ 2 • Tᗮ.starProjection (y - z)) x = ζ x ^ 2 * (hsNormSq (V.tangentProj x - T.starProjection) / 2) + 2 * ζ x * fderiv ℝ ζ x ((V.tangentProj x - T.starProjection) (Tᗮ.starProjection (x - z)))
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 2 of the supplied proof (Simon, Ch. 5, proof of Lemma 2.1, displays (1)-(3)).

Notation: A := p_{T^perp} = Tᗮ.starProjection, q := p_T = T.starProjection, p := P.starProjection = V.tangentProj x (hypothesis), w := A(x - z) (Simon's x'), and X(y) := zeta(y)^2 A(y - z). By the contract's definition, V.divM X x = trace(DX(x) o V.tangentProj x), with DX(x) = fderiv R X x.

1. The derivative of X at x. Since zeta is differentiable at x, y -> zeta(y)^2 is differentiable at x with derivative 2 zeta(x) D zeta(x) (chain rule, HasFDerivAt.pow). The map y -> A(y - z) is affine with derivative A (continuous linear map composed with a translation). By the product rule for scalar multiplication (HasFDerivAt.smul), X is differentiable at x and, for every v,
 DX(x) v = zeta(x)^2 A v + 2 zeta(x) (D zeta(x) v) w,
 i.e. DX(x) = zeta(x)^2 A + (2 zeta(x) D zeta(x)).smulRight(w).
2. Taking the trace after composing with p, and using linearity of the trace,
 V.divM X x = trace(DX(x) o p) = zeta(x)^2 trace(A o p) + trace( ((2 zeta(x) D zeta(x)) o p).smulRight(w) ),
 because (lambda.smulRight w) o p = (lambda o p).smulRight w for a linear functional lambda.
3. Rank-one trace: for a linear functional mu and a vector w, trace(v -> mu(v) w) = mu(w) (LinearMap.trace_smulRight). With mu = (2 zeta(x) D zeta(x)) o p this gives
 trace( ((2 zeta(x) D zeta(x)) o p).smulRight(w) ) = 2 zeta(x) D zeta(x)(p w).
4. w = A(x - z) lies in T^perp (Submodule.starProjection_apply_mem), and q vanishes on T^perp (Submodule.starProjection_apply_eq_zero_iff), so q w = 0 and p w = (p - q) w.
5. Since dim P = n = dim T, the sibling lemma aal_l1th_projection_algebra, part (ii), applied in R^{n+l} = Rn (n + l) (the same type as Amb n l), gives
 trace(A o p) = trace(p_{T^perp} o p_P) = hsNormSq(p_P - p_T) / 2.
6. Substituting 3, 4 and 5 into 2, and rewriting p = V.tangentProj x:
 V.divM X x = zeta(x)^2 * (hsNormSq(V.tangentProj x - T.starProjection) / 2) + 2 zeta(x) * D zeta(x)((V.tangentProj x - T.starProjection)(Tᗮ.starProjection(x - z))),
 which is the asserted identity. QED
proof_key_steps: DX(x) = zeta(x)^2 p_{T^perp} + (2 zeta(x) D zeta(x)).smulRight(x') with x' = p_{T^perp}(x - z) (product and chain rules).
trace(DX(x) o p_P) = zeta(x)^2 trace(p_{T^perp} p_P) + 2 zeta(x) D zeta(x)(p_P x') by linearity and the rank-one trace formula.
p_T x' = 0, so p_P x' = (p_P - p_T) x'.
trace(p_{T^perp} p_P) = hsNormSq(p_P - p_T)/2 by projection_algebra (ii); substitute p_P = V.tangentProj x.
